title: bole ro kar yahi alvida alvida
body:
bolo ro kar yahi alvida alvida
haaye bekas taqi alvida alvida
jaane qairul umam aap par ye sitam
moutasam tha shaqi alvida alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
aye raza ke nishaa'n aye imame zamaa'n
rounaqe hashmi alvida alvida
zulm tum ne saha uff na mu se kiya
jaanashine nabi alvida alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
qaak udhate hai sab sun ke haye haye ghazab
bekasi aap ki alvida alvida
